programmes.name_local: Ethiopia Ministry of Innovation and Technology startup and innovation support
programmes.name_en: Ethiopia Ministry of Innovation and Technology startup and innovation support
programmes.funder: Ministry of Innovation and Technology (MInT), Ethiopia
programmes.amount_note: MInT supports Ethiopian startups through incubation and acceleration partnerships and periodic innovation grant windows. Amounts are set per programme; there is no standing national startup grant with a published ceiling.
programmes.deadline_note: Support is delivered through discrete programmes and partner hubs rather than continuous intake.
programmes.reopen_note: Ethiopia's draft Startup Act (Startup Proclamation), which would create a national startup fund and labelling regime, has been under development for several years and has not been fully operationalised. Until it is, founders rely on MInT programmes, the Ethiopian Investment Holdings ecosystem and donor-funded hubs.

procedure_steps.detail: Monitor MInT announcements and partner incubators.
Apply to the specific open programme.

eligibility.other_note: Ethiopian-registered enterprises; foreign exchange and repatriation constraints materially affect startup financing in Ethiopia.
